title: Task Manager does not remember customized order of grouped windows after un-grouping
line: Windows you have arranged by hand keep their order after the Task Manager groups and ungroups them.
explanation: In manual sort mode, TasksModel keeps a sort map of all tasks. Whenever a group formed (for example with "only when the Task Manager is full"), consolidateManualSortMapForGroup() rewrote the group's entries in the grouping model's order, i.e. opening order, so the custom order was gone once the group split again. The consolidation now keeps the group's tasks in their existing sort map order around the group's first task; moving a group button captures that order before the move, and inline grouping keeps the old behaviour.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: keep the manual order of grouped tasks

When tasks got grouped in manual sort mode, their sort map entries were
rearranged in the order of the grouping model, so their custom order was
lost once ungrouped. Now the group's tasks keep their existing order.

BUG: 424836

media.caption: Three Konsoles, /usr dragged to the front (usr, tmp, etc)
Task Manager full: the Konsoles are grouped
After closing the other windows they ungroup as tmp, usr, etc: the manual order is lost
Same setup with the fix: usr, tmp, etc
Task Manager full: the Konsoles are grouped
After closing the other windows they ungroup as usr, tmp, etc

review.text: Right root cause and solid approach for preserving manual sort order across grouping and ungrouping in TasksModel without regressing inline grouping. However, in TasksModel::move(), setting newPos to sortedPreFilterRows.indexOf(preFilterRowIndex.row()) points into the middle of a reordered group whenever the grouping leader is not its first child; in !separateLaunchers mode (Icons-Only Task Manager), moving such a grouped pinned app left past another pinned app inserts its hidden launcher inside the group and causes beforeIdx at newPos - 1 to miss the preceding hidden launcher, regressing BUG 448912 / commit ea51795e8c. The patch should also guard against insertPos == -1 before removeAt() and add a regression test to tasksmodeltest.
changes: In TasksModel::move(), set newPos to d->sortedPreFilterRows.indexOf(groupRows.first()) when a group parent was moved (!groupRows.isEmpty()) so the !d->separateLaunchers launcher logic places the group's hidden launcher before the whole group block and detects a preceding hidden launcher at newPos - 1.

Guard against insertPos == -1 before calling sortedPreFilterRows.removeAt(insertPos) in consolidateManualSortMapForGroup(), and check adjacentGroupingRowIndex.isValid() before calling groupingProxyModel->rowCount(adjacentGroupingRowIndex).
Add an autotest in tasksmodeltest covering manual order preservation across grouping/ungrouping and moving a reordered pinned group in !separateLaunchers mode.
